headline: Approved one-time waiver of application deadline and approved Healthy Kingdom Cart for remainder of 2026-2027 season
summary: The committee discussed a late application from Prince Awhaitey of Healthy Kingdom and considered setting a precedent for late applicants. It then approved a one-time waiver of the application deadline and approved Healthy Kingdom Cart for the remainder of the 2026-2027 cart vending season.
decisions: Approved a one-time waiver of the application deadline.
Approved Healthy Kingdom Cart for the remainder of the 2026-2027 cart vending season.

Motion to approve Healthy Kingdom Cart for the remainder of the 2026-2027 cart vending season: Mark Bouchett ... Vote Approved Unanimously

plain_text:
CHURCH STREET MARKETPLACE CART VENDING COMMITTSS 
August 14, 2026 
1:00 PM 
 
Location: City Hall, Queen City Room, 149 Church St., Burlington, VT 
 
Attendance: 
Commissioners: Mark Bouchett(Zoom), Becky Holt(Zoom) 
Staff: Samantha McGinnis – CSM Director(Zoom), Andrew Bacher – CSM Coordinator  
COME TO ORDER 
a. Meeting is brought to order at 1:07pm by Mark Bouchett 
I. PUBLIC FORUM – GENERAL 
a. Opened at 1:07 pm 
b. Public forum closed at 1:07 pm 
 
II. HEALTHY KINGDOM CART LATE APPLICATION REQUEST 
a. Andrew Bacher presents the late application from Prince Awhaitey of Healthy Kingdom. Leads 
discussion on setting precedent allowing late applicants into the program. 
b. Mark Bouchett suggests creating a waiver process to allow one time waivers for qualified 
vendors to apply after the cart vending application deadline 
c. Motion to approve one time waiver of application deadline: Becky Holt 
a. Second: Mark 
b. No Discussion 
c. Vote approved unanimously 
d. Motion to approve Healthy Kingdom Cart for the remainder of the 2026-2027 cart vending 
season: Mark Bouchett 
a. Second: Becky 
b. No Discussion 
c. Vote Approved Unanimously 
III. Adjournment 
a) Meeting adjourned at 1:24 pm 
 
No future meeting schedule
